descriptor.detail: Built an embedding-backed recommender that stores module embeddings in pgvector and performs nearest-neighbour retrieval to surface content-similar modules. Implemented content-based ranking to mitigate cold-start and evaluated recommendations against historical course data.

one.descriptor: Computed module embeddings using a sentence-transformer and stored them in PostgreSQL with pgvector. Tuned ANN index and distance metrics for fast, accurate nearest-neighbour queries.

two.descriptor: Designed content-based ranking signals (syllabus, learning outcomes, tags) to generate recommendations for new modules with little or no interaction data, reducing dependence on collaborative signals.
